description: On-chain postage receipt for an openmail message. References a Paid event from Postage.sol on Base L2. Per ADR-2605172200.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte tx hash on the chain identified by `chain`.

chain.description: EIP-155 chain ID. 8453 = Base mainnet; 84532 = Base Sepolia.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed Postage.sol contract address that emitted the Paid event.

messageHash.description: keccak256 of the canonical CBOR encoding of the parent message record with `postage` field elided. Binds this payment to one specific record.

amountUsdc.description: USDC amount paid as a decimal string (e.g. '0.02'). Stored as string for precision.

paidAt.description: Block timestamp when Paid event was emitted.
